## 2. White‑Label Framework (Strict)

White‑label is allowed only under **controlled conditions**.

### What CAN Be White‑Labeled

* CGI Advertising assets
* Virtual Tours (with watermark control)
* AI Automation backends
* Reporting dashboards
* Predictive analytics outputs

### What is NEVER White‑Labeled

* Neon Vision AI identity
* Core automation logic
* Proprietary workflows
* Pricing logic & margins
* Internal tools or prompts

**Rule:** Clients can resell *outputs*, never *systems*.

## 3. White‑Label Operational Model

### Structure

* Partner sells under their brand
* DTM executes silently
* Neon Vision runs backend logic
* DTM owns infrastructure & data

### Access Control

* No raw system access
* Partner sees dashboards only
* No client‑to‑system exposure

### Failure Clause

If partner breaches:

* Immediate access revocation
* Asset ownership retained by DTM
* Non‑compete enforcement
